messages:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — RFC review block next Tue 10am PT. Need authors to claim slots and reviewers to confirm. aiming for 3 RFCs, 25m each + 10m buffer.
Priya Nair: I can take the middle slot. @Dom pls confirm your slot preference? Also can reviewers for model-infra and runtime confirm availability? :calendar:
Dom Rivera: I have a client call in the morning, can do the first slot (10:00-10:25). If folks need ordering change that's fine.
Jane K.: pre-read link? I can post checklist and short summary for attendees.
Carlos M.: model-infra review -> I can cover but prefer last slot so I can pull logs. runtime -> @Priya can you cover?
Priya Nair: yep I can do runtime review. Also suggesting swap RFC B before RFC A because B's outcome affects A's risk table.
Alex Chen: good call. New tentative order: Dom (RFC-B), Priya (RFC-A), Carlos (RFC-C). Will confirm once authors ack. Pls add 1-2 bullet "what to read" per pre-read.
Jane K.: posted pre-reads: https://example.com/pre-reads/rfc-block. Short TL;DRs + code pointers included.
CI-Bot: calendar invite created for Tue 10:00 PT with agenda + Google Meet link. Attendees: Alex Chen, Priya Nair, Dom Rivera, Jane K., Carlos M.
Alex Chen: thanks all — finalizing. Action items: authors add 2-line TL;DRs in doc, reviewers confirm by EOD Friday, I'll reorder agenda in invite. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: acked. I'll leave a note about runtime perf tests to look at.
Dom Rivera: ack.
Carlos M.: ack, will bring a short ops checklist.
Jane K.: added TL;DRs and a short test matrix.
Alex Chen: perfect — see you Tue. If anyone can't make it ping here and we'll find a swap.
